Create EmailInput component with async validation
Create PhoneInput component with format masking
Set up Jest + React Testing Library testing infrastructure
Write unit tests for all components

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Reusable form components created: TextInput, Select/Dropdown, DatePicker, EmailInput, PhoneInput, FormError, SuccessAlert, LoadingSpinner, ConfirmDialog
TextInput: real-time validation feedback, error message below field, required asterisk, helper text, red border on error
EmailInput: real-time email validation, async validation (check uniqueness via API), show "checking..." state
PhoneInput: phone format validation, auto-format input (user types, auto-formatted: (123) 456-7890)
DatePicker: calendar UI, date format validation, age calculation, max/min date constraints, disabled dates
Select/Dropdown: same validation features as TextInput, multi-select support optional
FormError: displays above form, red background, error icon, dismissible
SuccessAlert: green background with checkmark, auto-dismiss after 3 seconds
LoadingSpinner: centered spinner with optional backdrop, shows while API calls in progress
ConfirmDialog: modal with warning icon, Cancel and Delete buttons, requires confirmation before destructive action
All components follow Material Design 3 design system (colors, spacing, typography)
All components support dark mode (theme provider)
Accessibility: ARIA labels, proper heading structure, keyboard navigation

constraint.rule: All components must accept standard props: label (string), placeholder (string), value, onChange handler, error (boolean), errorMessage (string), disabled (boolean), required (boolean).
Components must work with form validation libraries (react-hook-form). Props should support: error (boolean), helperText (string), onBlur, onChange handlers.
All components must follow Material Design 3 design system. Use MUI theme provider for colors, spacing, typography. No hardcoded colors.
All components must respect MUI theme (light/dark mode). Use theme.palette.* instead of hardcoded colors. Provide contrast ratios for accessibility.
ARIA labels on all form inputs. Error messages linked via aria-describedby. ConfirmDialog with role="dialog". Screen reader support for all components. WCAG 2.1 AA compliance.
EmailInput supports async validation (check uniqueness). Show "checking..." state while async validation in progress. Handle debouncing to avoid excessive API calls.
PhoneInput automatically formats input as (123) 456-7890 while user types. Support multiple formats (+1-555-0123, (555) 0123, etc.).

interface.name: TextInput Component
interface.signature: TextInput: {label, placeholder, value, onChange, error?, errorMessage?, required?, disabled?, helperText?}
interface.description: Reusable text input component with validation feedback. Used in all forms throughout the application.

interface.name: EmailInput Component
interface.signature: EmailInput: {label, value, onChange, onBlur, error?, errorMessage?, isChecking?, required?} - supports async email uniqueness validation
interface.description: Email input with real-time format validation and async unique check via API.

interface.name: DatePicker Component
interface.signature: DatePicker: {label, value, onChange, error?, errorMessage?, minDate?, maxDate?, disabledDates?}
interface.description: Date picker with calendar UI from MUI X. Supports date constraints and validation.

interface.name: FormError Component
interface.signature: FormError: {message, onDismiss?} - displays form-level error above form
interface.description: Error alert component for displaying form-level validation or API errors.

interface.name: SuccessAlert Component
interface.signature: SuccessAlert: {message, duration?} - auto-dismisses after 3s by default
interface.description: Success notification component that auto-dismisses after configurable duration.

tests.standards: Unit tests use Jest + React Testing Library. Test component rendering, prop handling, validation feedback, event handlers, and accessibility features. Snapshot testing for UI consistency.
